<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/group/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sets the members with gpasswd -M, in place of the members that the group has. The same members, in any order, do not change it and report changed: false. A group that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.
